title: The Wrong Choir
author: Ivo Ishikawa
blurb: Freya Fairweather, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
